# Changeset guard patterns. Read by scripts/changeset-guard.sh, which runs in
# CI (.github/workflows/changeset_guard.yml) and in the local pre-push hook
# (scripts/hooks/pre-push). Both fail when a commit ADDS a file that matches a
# "block" line and no "allow" line. Files already in the repo are not checked.
#
# Format: one rule per line, "block <ERE>", "allow <ERE>" or "deny <ERE>". The
# ERE is matched case-insensitively (grep -iE) against the repo-relative path.
# "allow" wins over "block"; "deny" fails even when an "allow" line matches.
# Files over the size limit fail regardless of "allow".
# To add a legitimate path, add an "allow" line in the same PR; reviewers see it.

# Scratch directories and browser-automation output
block ^tmp/
block (^|/)\.playwright-mcp/

# Screenshots and documents dropped at the repo root
block ^[^/]+\.(png|jpe?g|pdf)$

# Scratch scripts
block (^|/)tmp_[^/]*\.py$

# Database dumps and backups
block \.sql$
block \.sql\.gz$
block \.(dump|bak)$

# Logs and archives
block \.log$
block \.(tgz|zip)$

# Secrets and keys ("deny": no allow rule exempts them)
block (^|/)\.env(\.[^/]*)?$
# credentials: only data/secret file types, so source such as
# ApiCredentialsService.java is not blocked.
deny credentials[^/]*\.(txt|json|env|properties|ya?ml|csv|xml|ini|conf|cfg|toml)$
deny (^|/)credentials$
deny \.pem$
deny (^|/)id_rsa[^/]*$
allow (^|/)\.env\.example$

# Legitimate SQL: database migrations and the reference SQL kept with the app
allow ^src/main/resources/db/migrations/.*\.sql$
allow ^src/main/resources/sql/.*\.sql$
allow ^src/main/webapp/resources/(sql|update)/.*\.sql$
